description_en: Updates the chunking strategy for a file in a knowledge base
description_zh: 更新知识库文件分块策略
name: UpdateKnowledgeBaseFileShardingStrategy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the knowledge base resides
parameters.help_zh: 知识库所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the knowledge base file
parameters.help_zh: 知识库文档的唯一标识
parameters.name: file_id

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens per chunk. The value must be a positive integer. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to hybrid
fields.help_zh: 单个分片的最大 Token 数量，必须为正整数。仅在 Type=hybrid 时生效
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to merge adjacent small chunks under the same heading. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to hybrid
fields.help_zh: 是否合并同一标题下相邻的小分片。仅在 Type=hybrid 时生效
fields.name: merge_peers

fields.help_en: The parameters of the default chunking strategy. MaxTokens and MergePeers are supported only when Type is set to hybrid
fields.help_zh: 默认分块策略参数。仅设置 Type=hybrid 时支持 MaxTokens 和 MergePeers
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en:
The type of the default chunking strategy. Valid values:
hybrid: Splits by document structure and limits the token count.
hierarchical: Splits only by document structure
fields.help_zh: 默认分块策略类型。取值：hybrid（按文档结构切分并限制 Token 数量）或 hierarchical（仅按文档结构切分）
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The default chunking strategy. This strategy is used when no rule is matched
fields.help_zh: 默认分块策略。没有规则命中时使用该策略
fields.name: default_strategy

fields.help_en: The content type. Currently, only table is supported, which matches content that is parsed as tables
fields.help_zh: 内容类型。当前仅支持 table，表示匹配被解析为表格的内容
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en: The rule match condition. Currently, only exact matching by content type for table content is supported
fields.help_zh: 规则匹配条件。当前仅支持按内容类型等值匹配表格内容
fields.name: match

fields.help_en:
The Markdown table processing mode. Valid values:
auto: Automatically determines the processing mode.
on: Forcefully enables Markdown table processing.
off: Disables Markdown table processing
fields.help_zh: Markdown 表格处理模式。取值：auto（自动判断）、on（强制开启）或 off（关闭）
fields.name: markdown_tables

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens per chunk for matched content. The value must be a positive integer. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to hybrid
fields.help_zh: 命中内容的单个分片最大 Token 数量，必须为正整数。仅在 Type=hybrid 时生效
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The chunking strategy parameters of the override rule. MaxTokens takes effect only when Type is set to hybrid. MarkdownTables supports auto, on, or off
fields.help_zh: 覆盖规则的分块策略参数。MaxTokens 仅在 Type=hybrid 时生效；MarkdownTables 支持 auto、on 或 off
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en:
The chunking strategy type of the override rule. Valid values:
hybrid
hierarchical
fields.help_zh: 覆盖规则的分块策略类型。取值：hybrid 或 hierarchical
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The chunking strategy to use when the rule is matched
fields.help_zh: 匹配成功后使用的分块策略
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The list of override rules that are matched in order. Currently, a maximum of one exact-match rule with ContentType set to table is supported
fields.help_zh: 按顺序匹配的覆盖规则列表。当前最多支持一条 ContentType=table 的等值匹配规则
fields.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The file-level chunking strategy configuration. This parameter is required when InheritSpaceStrategy is not set to true
parameters.help_zh: 文档级分块策略配置。InheritSpaceStrategy 不为 true 时必填
parameters.name: sharding_strategy_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restore inheritance of the chunking strategy from the knowledge space. When this parameter is set to true, ShardingStrategyConfig cannot be specified at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 是否恢复继承知识空间的分块策略。设置为 true 时不能同时指定 ShardingStrategyConfig
parameters.name: inherit_space_strategy
